ImageDescription.value: Sarkhej Roza is a mosque and tomb complex located in the village of Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, although there are many rozas across Gujarat, the Sarkhej Roza is the most revered, Sarkhej was once a prominent centre of Sufi culture in the country, where influential Sufi saint Shaikh Ahmed Ganj Baksh lived, Sarkhej Roza is an example of the early Islamic architectural culture of the region, which fused Islamic stylistic influences from Persia with Indian Hindu and Jain features to form a composite Indo-Saracenic architectural style.
